knowledgeAnswers.rationale: SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), indoor-pool permit drawings: the drawings must show the barrier, the child-resistant doorsets and the direction the door swings.

Practice rule in this lesson, not an SP 02 or SP 01 statement: stop work in the affected area, record the position, and report to the builder and building surveyor. Do not adjust the precaution yourself.
SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), recirculation and filtration designs: they must be given to the relevant building surveyor with the building permit application.

practicalCriteria: From a supplied permit, identifies the SP 01 start and finish time limits for the pool and barrier work, and records the issue date and planned dates in a supplied log.
In a supplied scenario with a moved precaution, stops work in the affected area, records the position, and reports to the named recipients without altering the precaution.
Identifies from a supplied scenario that unpermitted work is continuing, and escalates it in writing.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Permit and time-limit log for the assessed project
Stop-work and report record for the supplied scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Precaution moved or altered: stop in the affected area and report; do not correct it yourself.
Work continuing without a permit: stop and escalate in writing.
Young children at risk from unfinished work: stop, secure the area, and escalate urgently.
